stories.title: Alonso's Summer Break Decision — Retire or Race On in 2027?

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Fernando Alonso is 44. His Aston Martin contract expires this year.

The summer break is his deadline.

Ted Kravitz says he'll retire. Spanish sources say it's already decided.

But then the B-spec arrived: "That adrenaline was missed." 🔥

#F1 #AstonMartin

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
One article: "Alonso staying — B-spec gives him reason to race on."
One reporter: "Alonso retiring — he wants other challenges."

Both could be right.

He said he'd decide after the summer break.

The Dutch GP is Aug 21. We'll know soon. 🏁

#F1 #AstonMartin

This one will be emotional. 🧡
